description: Switches an adjustable regulator on or off and sets its output voltage and current limit.

activation.text: Runs every pass while enabled: a setting is sent on the first pass and whenever it changes.

fields.description: What the block does once when it stops being enabled.

options.description: Leave the regulator as it is.
Switch the output off. The voltage and the limit are kept.

variants.description: Switches the regulator output on or off. It returns at once: wait for the regulator's ready event before using the rail. The power manager may refuse it against the power budget.

Sets the wanted output voltage; the output follows when it is on. The regulator keeps it while the output is off. A higher voltage returns at once: wait for the ready event. The power manager may refuse it against the power budget.
Sets the wanted output current limit. The regulator keeps it while the output is off.
